# Korean Market Analysis (2026-10-01)
**KOSPI Performance & Global Context:**
The KOSPI closed at 6,813.15 [edc816a9], while the S&P 500 stood at 7,651.54 [0b12d0fa]. Volatility remains contained with VIX at 16.34 [6a4d957f], suggesting measured risk appetite. However, the U.S. 10-year yield has climbed to 5.293% [ede20296], creating headwinds for equity valuations regionally.
**Macro & Commodity Pressures:**
U.S. inflation cooled to 3.4% [market-analysis:macro.cpi], yet the Fed Funds rate remains elevated at 3.63% [market-analysis:macro.fed-rate]. Oil (WTI) trades at $90.4/barrel [21dd13a2] amid Middle East tensions, while gold has surged to $4,174.1/oz [89dea093]—traditional safe-haven moves reflecting geopolitical risk.
**Sentiment & Outlook:**
The Fear & Greed index stands at 31 [market-analysis:fear-greed], signaling fear dominance. According to Reuters and WSJ headlines, equity markets remain mixed despite moderating inflation, with tech (Micron earnings strength) offsetting broader uncertainty. Monitor: whether yield stabilization occurs, Middle East escalation, and whether the Dollar Index (101.49 [69db72fe]) sustains strength—all could alter KOSPI direction.
